scientific_integrity: Exact exhaustive finite classification with two independent checkers and all sixteen equality cases; the proof of exhaustive coverage uses monotonicity and increasing-word enumeration. Historical source dates without a verified exact day are not assigned artificial days; 2004-01-26 is the earliest exact first-publication day verified among the directly date-stamped primary sources.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion covers binary length-six comma-free codes with aligned minimum Hamming distance three. It does not establish framing-error correction, higher-length bounds, or exhaustive global bibliographic uniqueness. Computations are complete for their finite declared domain.
title: Six-word extremum and complete equality classification for one-error-correcting binary comma-free codes
